scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "bun run dev:api" "bun run dev:web"
scripts.build: bun run --filter '@product-os/shared' build && bun run --filter '@product-os/api' build && bun run --filter '@product-os/web' build
scripts.build:api: cd packages/shared && bun run build && cd ../api && bun run build
scripts.build:web: cd packages/shared && bun run build && cd ../web && bun run build
scripts.build:desktop: cd packages/web && bun run build && cd ../desktop && cargo tauri build
